text:
incident-bot: PAGER -> [high] GPU ECC errors spike on gpu-node-23 (region-us-west-2). Alert: ECC_ERRORS >= 1 in 5m. Link: https://ops/redwood/alerts/1769994321

maya: @channel paging in, I'm awake. pulling logs now.

maya: quick glance: ECC counters incrementing on node gpu-node-23, thermal also trending up to ~82C. not yet a crash but kernel drained 1 pod earlier.

samir: on my way. do we need to evict?

maya: planning to cordon & drain if ECC keeps rising. want to check `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used,memory.total,temperature.gpu,health.thermal --format=csv` and dmesg for GPU ECC entries first.

lee: FYI some customer jobs on that node are 12h long. need graceful eviction.

maya: will `kubectl drain gpu-node-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120` and set `--force` only if pods don't exit. posting before action.

infra-bot: Deploy job 9412 completed on node gpu-node-24 (unrelated).

maya: running commands, output snippets:
```
$ nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,index,utilization.gpu,memory.used,memory.total,temperature.gpu,ecc.errors.uncorrected --format=csv
2026-03-15 10:04:01,0,12 %,10240 MiB,16384 MiB,81 C,2
2026-03-15 10:04:01,1,8 %,8192 MiB,16384 MiB,82 C,1
```

maya: dmesg shows `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 61, CE error detected on physical GPU 0` entries.

samir: agreed drain. initiating now.

maya: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-23` -> `node/gpu-node-23 cordoned`

maya: `kubectl drain gpu-node-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120` -> evicting pods, 3 long-running jobs still in Terminating. pinging sched team for faster preemption. @rachel can we allow reclaim on these jobs?

rachel: on it — bumping priority for evac. also starting a parallel reboot of the node after evictions.

ajohnson: tagging infra: possible flaky power rail? saw similar ECC + thermal pattern on node gpu-node-11 last quarter.

maya: marking incident as "customer impact possible" — some jobs will be rescheduled, might see slight latency for queued requests on dedicated pools.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED -> INC-2026-0315-01 (severity: P2). Paging oncall, escalation to eng-sre.

lee: customers with running notebooks on that node: acct-77, acct-209. notifying owners via email.

samir: node drained, pods evicted, rebooting node: `sudo reboot` -> remote KVM shows node back online. running self-checks.

maya: post-reboot `nvidia-smi` shows ECC counters reset to 0, temps back to 49C, utilization normal.

rachel: thanks team. setting immediate mitigation as completed. marking resolved in incident tracker once we finish postmortem.

maya: quick note: the alert that paged us is `ECC_ERRORS >= 1 in 5m` — that's very noisy. got paged twice on this metric last 48h for nodes that recovered by rebooting. proposing changes in the follow-up: increase threshold and add aggregation by node over 10m, and require thermal >80C OR ECC >3 to page.

samir: +1. also add a suppressed alert for single transient ECC events (they often follow firmware transient). keep lower-severity log-only alert for observability.

lee: proposal sketch for alert rule (pseudo):
```
ALERT GPUNodeECCHigh
  IF sum_over_time(ecc_errors_total{job="gpu_exporter"}[10m]) by (node) >= 3
  AND max_over_time(temperature_gpu_c{job="gpu_exporter"}[10m]) by (node) > 80
  FOR 2m
```

lee: that will cut noise and only page when both ECC and thermal are sustained.

rachel: also seeing a different noisy alert: VRAM_USAGE > 95% for 1m. users burst and cause transient alerts. suggest changing to 98% for dedicated nodes, and longer FOR clause (5m) for shared clusters.

maya: +1 to both. need a brief dashboard change too: add panel showing `ecc_errors_total` per GPU over 24h with heatmap and overlay for kernel reboots. that'll help root cause.

ajohnson: we should also add a Grafana alert to create an annotation when we auto-reboot nodes so we can correlate reboots with ECC spikes.

samir: action items (quick):
- maya: open INC postmortem draft, include timeline + commands used (due EOD today)
- lee: implement new Prometheus rule PR for ECC/thermal threshold + VRAM delta (due tomorrow)
- rachel: create Grafana dashboard panels and annotation rule (due +2 days)
- ajohnson: hardware ticket to vendor for gpu-node-23 (collect ECC history dump) (due +3 days)

maya: handing off oncall to @samir — summary: node gpu-node-23 had transient ECC spikes with thermal rise, drained and rebooted, service restored, customers rescheduled. alert rule to be tuned to reduce noise.

samir: taking over oncall. I'll watch related alerts and follow up on PR reviews.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded: from maya to samir at 2026-03-15T10:20:40Z.

maya: quick post-incident note: we should consider adding a health-exporter metric for `ecc_errors_uncorrected` and `ecc_errors_corrected` separately, and a rolling counter so we can alert on rate rather than instantaneous counts.

lee: agree — will add metrics proposal to the PR.

rachel: thanks everyone. closing the pager for now. please don't forget to tag follow-ups in the postmortem so we can close the loop. :white_check_mark:

samir: ACK. will ping when alerts rule PR is merged. :thumbsup:
